entries.prompt:
Create ONE SQUARE realistic sci-fi game terrain texture atlas, a strict 2x2 contact sheet containing exactly FOUR equal-size square panels. Entire canvas fully filled; NO gutters, NO divider lines, NO text, NO labels. Panel order top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. Each panel is its own complete independent top-down 90-degree orthographic battleground, separated cleanly at 50% canvas axes with no objects crossing panels. Match premium realistic EVE-inspired Mars science fiction, photoreal detailed PBR materials, physically realistic light, muted rust orange / charcoal / industrial metal. NOT stylized, NOT pixel art, NOT vector illustration, NOT game screenshot. Every panel retains its central 60% visually calm and free for fleet combat overlays; detailed facilities/terrain chiefly toward its outer 20%. No ships, people, interface, holograms, drawn circles, arrows, glowing paths, icons, compass, border or frame. Four panels:
1. orbital territory: black deep space above Mars limb in bottom left quarter, tiny derelict satellite near far edge, center open starfield
2. mining site: rust terrain with realistic open-pit ore extraction terraces along left and right edges, mechanical excavation equipment tiny at edges, flat dusty center
3. canyon outpost: Martian canyon with photoreal jagged red cliffs at sides, a tiny industrial outpost along upper border, wide open central canyon floor
4. polar ice: Mars white blue carbon-dioxide ice sheets and cracked dark rock, frost deposits, open pale central plain
Maintain 4 distinct compositions and highest texture detail.
